sections.title: /ultrafast, Claude Maintains Apps & Google Docs in ChatGPT / Ultrafast、Claude 维护应用与 ChatGPT 集成 Docs
sections.desc: Sottiaux 的 /ultrafast（**2723 赞**+ Altman 转发 **1638 赞**）+ Google Docs 集成（**1560 赞**）+ 电脑烤言（**1280 赞**）；Boris Cherny 的 Claude 维护实验（**2939 赞）；Thariq 的「一切皆代码」（**463 赞**）。

cards.authorTag: OpenAI / OpenAI CEO / Claude Code @Anthropic / Anthropic

rewrite: Sottiaux ships /ultrafast (2723 likes), with Altman co-signing '/ultrafast' (1638 likes). Plus Google Docs integration (1560 likes): 'Work with Google docs, sheets and slides right inside ChatGPT. This has changed how I write documents, brainstorm or proofread things. I just open it and then chat or talk my way through changes and it all happens right there in the flow.' And the roast-your-usage plugin (1280 likes): 'Ask ChatGPT to roast your computer usage after a day. Install the Computer History plugin... It's... insightful. You don't use Slack. Slack uses you. It accounted for 48% of your recorded activity. Your Mac is essentially a $3,000 Slack notification with a keyboard.'

Boris Cherny's Claude-maintains-apps experiment (2939 likes): 'A weird experiment: having Claude take over day-to-day maintenance of our apps. Seeing early signs of life that this might be possible. We have a Slack channel called proj-claude-maintains-apps. In it, Claude Tag runs a bunch of daily routines across iOS, Android, Desktop, web, CLI, and Agent SDK: Crash fuzzer, regression tests, performance monitoring.' Thariq declares (463 likes): 'everything truly is code.'

Boris Cherny 的 Claude 维护实验（2939 赞）：一个奇怪的实验——让 Claude 接管应用的日常维护。看到了可能成功的早期迹象。设置很直接：一个叫 proj-claude-maintains-apps 的 Slack 频道，Claude Tag 在其中每天在 iOS、Android、桌面、web、CLI 和 Agent SDK 上跑一堆例行任务：崩椃 fuzzer、回归测试、性能监控。Thariq 宣判（463 赞）：一切皆代码。

sections.title: Engineers Un-eliminated, ARC-AGI Harness & Optional Computers / 工程师未被消灭、ARC-AGI Harness 与可选电脑
sections.desc: Levie 驳消灭论（187 赞）；Zara 的工程师职位观察（106 赞）；Amjad 的电脑可选预言（**717 赞**）+ ARC-AGI-3（100 赞）+ Replit 印证（305 赞）；Matt Turck 的二元论（**256 赞**）；Rauchg 的统一命令预言（148 赞）。

cards.authorTag: Box CEO / Builder / Replit CEO / FirstMark / Vercel CEO

rewrite: Levie rebuts the elimination hypothesis (187 likes): 'The elimination of engineers was one of the wilder hypotheses out there. Just absurdly wrong. We just gave engineers a power tool. Their value not only remains critical, but actually goes up in many domains because we can apply engineering to far more work than before.' Zara's observation (106 likes): 'Ironic that many people thought AI coding would make engineers less valuable when in reality the most in-demand jobs all have the word engineer in them: forward-deployed engineer, design engineer, product engineer, growth engineer.' Amjad's prediction (717 likes): 'By next year, using a computer will be optional. Work will radically change.' Plus ARC-AGI-3 nearly solved by adding a coding harness (100 likes) and Replit confirmation (305 likes).

Matt Turck's bifurcation (256 likes): 'Right now, you're either an AI-native rocketship — permanent fundraising at scary valuations, death match for customers, sacrificing margins — or basically left for dead, regardless of how good a company you actually are.' Rauchg's one-command prediction (148 likes): 'One command to rule them all (tokens). I predict this will become the default way of using coding AI at scale. Uptime, model choice, lower costs, observability, ZDR. This command configures every existing coding harness, like Claude Code & Codex!'

Amjad Masad: By next year, using a computer will be optional. Work will radically change.

rewrite: Levie 驳斥消灭假设（187 赞）：消灭工程师是最狂野的假设之一。荒谬地错。我们只是给工程师一个动力工具。他们的价值不仅保持关键，在很多领域还上升——因为工程化可以应用到远比以往多的工作上。Zara 的观察（106 赞）：许多人以为 AI 编码会让工程师贬值，现实是最抢手的职位全带“工程师”：前线部署工程师、设计工程师、产品工程师、增长工程师。Amjad 预言（717 赞）：明年用电脑将是可选的。工作将彻底改变。加上 ARC-AGI-3 仅靠加编码 harness 就几乎被解决（100 赞）和 Replit 印证（305 赞）。
Matt Turck 的二元论（256 赞）：现在你要么是 AI 原生火箭——永久融资、越来越吓人的估值、为抢客户不惜牺牲毛利的死亡竞赛；要么基本上被判死刑，不管你公司实际多好。Rauchg 的统一命令预言（148 赞）：一条命令统治所有 token。我预言这将成为大规模使用编码 AI 的默认方式。可用性、模型选择、更低成本、可观测性。这条命令配置所有现有编码 harness！

sections.title: Grok Bot, Prompt Debt & Home Robots / Grok Bot、提示债与家庭机器人
sections.desc: Nikunj 论超级 agent vs 专用 agent（**176 赞**）；Madhu Guru 论提示债（49 赞）+ Studio 命名漪潮（12 赞）；Ryo Lu 的 Matic 机器人（217 赞）+ Peter Yang 的家庭观察（24 赞）+ Nikunj 的儿子与 Matic（63 赞）；Dan Shipper 的求职浪潮（88 赞）；Garry Tan 的州长候选人聚会（129 赞）。

cards.authorName: Nikunj / Madhu / Ryo Lu / Peter Yang / Shipper / Tan
cards.authorTag: FPV / Product / Cursor / Builder / Every / YC

rewrite: Nikunj on Grok Bot vs super agent (176 likes): 'Grok Bot is a fantastic release.. the UX, the design, the onboarding: chef's kiss. But I go back and forth: Will users want one super agent that holds all the context, or sub agents designated to do a slice of tasks? If we treat agents as humans, then the Grok Bot design makes a ton of sense. It allows us to compartmentalize tools, context, outcomes.' Madhu Guru on prompt debt (49 likes): 'Prompt debt is the new tech debt. With every model update, you should be cutting at least 50% of your prompts. Most AI products have bloated prompts that are making your product quality worse. The typical flow: model fails at something -> add 10 rules. 3 months later, your system prompt is a novel.' Plus the Studio naming epidemic (12 likes): 20+ products all named Studio.

Ryo Lu on the Matic robot (217 likes): 'matic is the first robot I've owned that actually feels like it gets smarter with every update.' Peter Yang's floor-cleaning observation (24 likes) and Nikunj's family-fifth-member note (63 likes): 'Matic was one of the first ten words my son learned.' Dan Shipper's application flood (88 likes): averaging 2 applications per minute from Citadel, OpenAI, Red Bull, Microsoft, NASDAQ, Google, PwC, Square. Garry Tan hosting California gubernatorial hopeful Xavier Becerra (129 likes) and topics-per-bot request (281 likes).

sections.title: Podcast: Chess.com — Superhuman Machines & Timeless Games / 播客：Chess.com——超人机器与永恒游戏
sections.desc: No Priors 采访 Chess.com CEO Erik Allebest，论 2.5 亿会员、2 亿美元营收、AI 与棋牌的共生、反作弊战争与创始人哲学。完整 transcript（50546 字符）已翻译。

cards.authorTag: Erik Allebest（Chess.com CEO 与创始人）

rewrite: No Priors: Elad Gil interviews Erik Allebest, CEO/co-founder of Chess.com — bought the domain out of a bankruptcy auction in 2005 for $55K when VCs called it 'uninvestable'. Today: 250M+ members, ~10M daily actives, $200M+ revenue, 650 people, zero outside capital. Key topics: the COVID/Queen's Gambit wave and the 2023 short-form-content wave (mittens bot, cheating scandal) that compounding growth; Lichess as 'the Linux of chess' — coexisting via open source; chess not being patentable — winning via product, community, content; computers first making chess boring, then making it more exciting than ever (Leela Chess Zero's aggressive unconventional play); AI coach on game review, personalized puzzles; younger and younger prodigies (7-year-olds challenging grandmasters); repetition as the unshortcutable path to expertise ('any given day multiplied by a thousand is your life'); cheating as an arms race — statistical models that know how humans vs computers play; chess as the Beatles in a world of infinite AI-generated music — timeless shared experience with no loot boxes or new heroes; Gambit poker with chess-style ratings ('how good are you really, not how many chips can you buy'); founder advice: 'listen to your heart, not the founder-advice industrial complex'; and AGI optimism tempered by cultural concerns about wealth concentration.
original: Erik Allebest: We have about 10,000,000 daily active users, more than 250,000,000 registered members. This year we'll do a little over $200,000,000.
Erik Allebest: Computers at first made chess a little bit more boring, but then made it so much more exciting. We're seeing more exciting chess than we ever have.
Erik Allebest: It's the same as when you train a neural net. You have to put in the repetitions. You can't really shortcut practice.
Erik Allebest: There's no loot boxes. There's no new skins. There's no new heroes to learn. You're having the same shared experience forever.
Erik Allebest: How good are you really? Not just can you buy the most chips.
Erik Allebest: People should listen to their heart. Just go execute and put something beautiful into the world.

rewrite: No Priors：Elad Gil 采访 Chess.com CEO 与创始人 Erik Allebest——2005 年从破产拍卖中以 5.5 万美元买下域名，当时 VC 称其「不可投资」。如今：2.5 亿+会员、约 1000 万日活、2 亿美元+营收、650 人团队、零外部资本。核心话题：COVID/后束、骗开与 2023 短视频内容浪潮（趾子机器人、作弊丑闻）如何复利增长；Lichess 是「棋牌界的 Linux」——开源共存；棋牌不可专利——靠产品、社区、内容取胜；电脑起先让棋牌变乏味，后来让它比以往任何时候都精彩（Leela Zero 的激进非传统下法）；游戏复盘 AI 教练、个性化谜题；神童越来越年轻（7 岁孩挑战特级大师）；重复是不可走捷径的专家之路（「任何一天乘以千就是你的人生」）；作弊是军备竞赛——知道人类和电脑各自怎么下棋的统计模型；棋牌是无限 AI 音乐世界里的披头士——无战利品箱、无新英雄的永恒共同体验；Gambit 德州扑克带棋牌式积分（「你真正有多好，而不是能买多少筹码」）；创始人忠告：「听你的心，别听创始人建议工业复合体」；以及对 AGI 谨慎乐观+对财富集中的文化担忧。
original: 【从破产拍卖到 2.5 亿会员】
Allebest：2005 年从破产拍卖中以 5.5 万美元买下 chess.com 域名。几乎所有投资人都说这不可投资、该找份正经工作。
「如今约 1000 万日活、4-5 亿月活、2.5 亿注册会员。今年营收将超过 2 亿美元。团队约 650 人。」
「我们从未融资，按现金流速度增长，早早盈利。当初以为 50 人就到顶了。」
【AI 与棋牌的共生】
Allebest：电脑起先让棋牌有点乏味，但后来让它比以往任何时候都精彩。Leela Zero 下得激进、非传统，推动了棋理进步。
「游戏复盘的 AI 教练、为你生成的个性化谜题——AI 真正帮人类更享受棋牌。”
「7 岁孩子在挑战特级大师。英国的 10 岁印度裔女孩横扫所有人。这代孩子有了超人工具，学得更快。”
【重复与专家之路】
Allebest：把任何一天乘以一千，那就是你的人生。每天 5 个谜题，乘以一千就是 5000 个。
「训练神经网也是一样——得把重复灌进脑子。练习没有捷径。”
【作弊与棋牌的永恒性】
Allebest：作弊无法完全防止——你不能在每个人家装摄像头。但我们有统计模型和机器学习，知道人怎么下、电脑怎么下。
「棋牌没有战利品箱、没有新皮肤、没有新英雄。规则最简，完全信息博弈，零运气。它是无限内容世界里的披头士。”
【Gambit 德州扑克与创始哲学】
Allebest：我们把棋牌的打法带到德州扑克——按积分而非筹码。你真正有多好？
「当年的创业圣经是：斯坦禅技术联创、融大资、大市场、烧钱获客。我们全反着来。听你的心。”
「把独一无二的美好东西带到世上，其余的都会解决。别再听别人的创业建议了。”
